_comment: Level scaling. Mob, player-base, pet-base and regen data are in classic_base.json (WoW Classic emulator data). This file holds the gear profiles and the pet ability ranks (Wowhead Forever).

profiles.source: PLACEHOLDERS: gear bonuses added to the gnome warlock's base stats (classic_base.json): value = at40 + perLevel x (level-40). The real gear of the player is not known; replace with real totals (Stamina, Intellect, Spirit, spell power, crit, hit, armor).

imp.fireboltSource: Wowhead Forever spell pages (https://www.wowhead.com/forever/spell=<id>), fetched 2026-11-25 ids 3110,7799,7800,7801,7802,11762,11763; rank levels from allthings.how/?p=353577. The 10 Nov hotfix raised the base damage of ranks 1-4 (wiki tooltip rank 1 '4 to 5' is older than Wowhead value 6). Pet spell power assumed = Demonic Knowledge bonus only.

succubus.lashSource: Wowhead Forever spell pages (https://www.wowhead.com/forever/spell=<id>), fetched 2026-11-25 ids 7814,7815,7816,11778,11779,11780; 12 s cooldown (wiki).

voidwalker.tormentNote: Torment: 5 s cooldown, 20 mana, taunt (allthings.how/?p=353577). The threat amount and the Torment mana use are NOT known (estimate).

pets.source_unconfirmed: Pet health, mana, armor and melee damage come from classic_base.json (WoW Classic pet_levelstats and the cmangos pet damage formula) with Forever's rules applied: +2 health per point of the master's Stamina, +15% base health (hotfix 10 Nov), Voidwalker +40 (6 Nov). These are NOT Forever tooltips. Pet abilities (Firebolt, Lash of Pain): Wowhead Forever.

consumables.source: Wowhead Forever item pages (tooltips, fetched 25 Nov 2026): vendor drinks Sweet Nectar 1708 (req 25): 1345 mana over 27 s; Moonberry Juice 1645 / Bottled Winterspring Water 19300 (req 35): 1915 over 30 s; Morning Glory Dew 8766 (req 45): 2821 over 30 s. Vendor food: req 25 (e.g. Stormwind Brie 1707): 841 health over 27 s; req 35 (Cured Ham Steak 4599): 1338 over 30 s; req 45 (Roasted Quail 8952, Homemade Cherry Pie 8950): 2065 over 30 s. Levels 1-24 (Wowhead Forever item tooltips, 25 Nov 2026; food durations 18/21/24 s are the Classic ones, the tooltip text could not be parsed for them): Refreshing Spring Water 159: 151 mana over 18 s; Ice Cold Milk 1179 (req 5): 437 over 21 s; Melon Juice 1205 (req 15): 835 over 24 s; Tough Hunk of Bread 4540: 61 health over 18 s; Freshly Baked Bread 4541 (req 5): 243 over 21 s; Moist Cornbread 4542 (req 15): 552 over 24 s. Levels 1-24 (Wowhead Forever item tooltips, 25 Nov 2026; the food durations 18/21/24 s are the Classic ones, the tooltip text could not be parsed for them): Refreshing Spring Water 159: 151 mana over 18 s; Ice Cold Milk 1179 (req 5): 437 over 21 s; Melon Juice 1205 (req 15): 835 over 24 s; Tough Hunk of Bread 4540: 61 health over 18 s; Freshly Baked Bread 4541 (req 5): 243 over 21 s; Moist Cornbread 4542 (req 15): 552 over 24 s. Best vendor item for the level; Alterac Manna Biscuit (req 51) is not general vendor stock. Whether drinking adds Spirit regeneration on top of the tooltip is unknown (assumed not).

healthFunnel._source: Wowhead Forever spells 755, 3698, 3699, 3700, 11693, 11694, 11695 (https://www.wowhead.com/forever/spell=<id>, read 27 Nov 2026): 10 s channel; the demon gains healPerSec every second, the warlock pays costBase health plus costPerSec every second.

demonArmor.source: seemeta.com Forever abilities: Demon Armor ranks at levels 20/30/40/50/60: armor 210/300/390/480/570
